fields.title: gov.sr Suriname tender record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER (listType=tenders, a thin ministry-level procurement notice from the `aanbestedingen` custom post type) or TENDER_NOTICE (listType=notices, a richer internationally/donor-financed solicitation from the 'Aanbestedingen' blog category, with full bid text). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:tenders' or 'list:notices'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-wp-rest-aanbestedingen-cpt, S1-wp-rest-posts-category-aanbestedingen, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient or category_not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

title.title: Title
title.description: What is being procured. TENDER titles are usually Dutch; TENDER_NOTICE titles are usually English.

link.title: URL
link.description: Canonical gov.sr URL for this notice's own page.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp this notice was published on gov.sr.

modifiedAt.title: Modified at
modifiedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp this notice was last edited on gov.sr.

ministry.title: Ministry / sector
ministry.description: TENDER only -- the government body's WordPress category name, e.g. 'Openbare Werken & Ruimtelijke Ordening' (Public Works & Spatial Planning).

ministrySlug.title: Ministry / sector slug
ministrySlug.description: TENDER only -- the WordPress category slug for `ministry`, usable as the `categorySlug` input filter.

ministryCategories.title: Additional ministry/sector tags
ministryCategories.description: TENDER only -- present only when a notice carries more than one category; the full list of names (ministry already includes the first one).

categoryIds.title: Category IDs
categoryIds.description: TENDER only -- raw WordPress category term IDs, upstream passthrough.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: TENDER_NOTICE only -- WordPress category name(s) applied to this notice.

excerptText.title: Excerpt (plain text)
excerptText.description: TENDER_NOTICE only -- WordPress auto-excerpt, HTML stripped.

contentText.title: Full bid text (plain text)
contentText.description: TENDER_NOTICE only -- the notice's full body (background, procurement method, eligibility, bid evaluation, submission deadline/address), HTML stripped to plain text.

contentHtml.title: Full bid text (HTML)
contentHtml.description: TENDER_NOTICE only -- the notice's full body exactly as rendered by WordPress, upstream passthrough.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
